# messq_completion_fish

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq completion fish

emit the fish completion script

### Synopsis

Emit the fish completion script for the messq command tree onto stdout.
Source it from your fish startup file; it wires the __complete protocol so
flags, commands and help topics finish on TAB. The script itself is static; the
live stream and consumer names it offers are fetched per keystroke on the
resolver's 200ms budget, and a dead daemon simply completes nothing, silently.

```
messq completion fish [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  source <(messq completion fish)
```
